conclusion: All 20 runs have complete evidence, and no declared chart signal appeared. Review found real application errors mixed with apparent grader false alarms. These results do not yet establish an accepted baseline of application quality.
chart_note: Dashed lines are calculated from these same 20 observations, not independent validation. No point exceeds a limit and no eight consecutive points lie strictly on one side. Back-to-back, partly concurrent runs mainly describe short-term variation. Points are ordered by start time, not run number or elapsed time.
provenance: Collected October 15, 2026 with GPT-6 Luna for the assistant, judges and restored merge guard; 51 visible synthetic cases × 3 attempts × 20 runs. Original grades retained. The later contextual completeness grader was not used for this collection. Examples were selected to illustrate review decisions, not estimate grader accuracy. No real user conversations, trace links or provider credentials are included.
